candidate_structure.information_flow: The first call receives every common input and emits an authoritative non-policy obligation charter. The final call consumes only that immediately preceding charter, receives no reopened common input, creates the lineage's first executable artifact, and emits one policy.
candidate_structure.name: Pre-Artifact Constitutional Cut
candidate_structure.organization: two-call sequential lineage with full-context policy-free authority followed by source-blind sole policy materialization

calls.objective: Interpret the six visible inputs jointly and emit an authoritative policy-free analysis of obligations, conflicts, and acceptance boundaries without creating an executable artifact.
Consume constitute_policy_free_charter as the sole visible evidence, realize its settled obligations in one complete policy, and emit that policy without reopening source evidence.

mode_certificate.forbidden_inherited_mechanism: progressive mutation of one complete executable artifact across disjoint downstream evidence-window reentries
mode_certificate.independent_replacement_principle: bind all source evidence once into a policy-free obligation charter, then permit exactly one source-blind transition that creates the policy
rejected_assumptions: An executable artifact must exist before evidence authority can be settled.
Disjoint downstream evidence reentry is necessary to reconcile obligations.
Continuous custody of a mutable executable artifact is safer than policy-free precommitment.

qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Place a binding pre-artifact authority cut between full-context interpretation and policy creation: the first call emits only an obligation charter, and a source-blind terminal call creates the sole executable policy.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: Settling obligations before executable form exists should change both scan-resistance behavior and phase-shift adaptation behavior while making object-versus-byte objective balancing less dependent on inherited artifact form.
qualitative_hypothesis.falsifier: all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score
qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The active family settles evidence through an early executable artifact, leaving later calls constrained by that artifact's path dependence and by partial evidence reentry.

structural_mutation.after: One full-context policy-free charter becomes the sole edge into a terminal materializer; raw evidence has no downstream edge, and executable state begins only at the final call.
structural_mutation.before: Immediate executable creation followed by disjoint raw-evidence reentries that mutate the inherited complete artifact.
structural_mutation.factor: pre-artifact authority cut with source-blind terminal materialization
structural_mutation.why_structural: The single authority cut removes reentry edges, changes evidence timing from post-artifact repair to pre-artifact settlement, and relocates executable-state creation to one terminal transition.

receipt.role: score-blind R91 counter_hypothesis structure architect; never policy code
